Stars, levels, powers, achievements
and your daily streak will be lost.
This cannot be undone.
Modo infinito liberado! As fases\nagora:
Infinite mode unlocked! Levels
now go on forever.
Toque em 2 ou mais blocos iguais\nencost:
Tap 2 or more matching blocks
that touch to pop them!
Sem jogadas! Use um poder\nou embaralhe:
No moves left! Use a power
or shuffle the board.
Martelo: toque no bloco\nque quer destru:
Hammer: tap the block
you want to destroy.
Troca: toque em dois blocos\npara trocá-:
Swap: tap two blocks
to switch their places.
Este é o Martelo! Ele destrói\nqualquer:
This is the Hammer! It destroys
any block without using a move.
Tap it.
Este bloco está sozinho e não\nestoura c:
This block is alone and won't
pop with a normal tap.
Use the Hammer on it!
Agora a Troca: ela muda dois blocos\nde:
Now the Swap: it switches two blocks,
also without using a move.
Tap it.
Estes dois vão trocar de lugar.\nToque n:
These two will switch places.
Tap the one with the yellow border...
...e agora neste. Eles trocam\nde lugar:
...and now this one. They switch
places and make a group!
Pronto! Você tem %d Martelos e %d Trocas:
Done! You have %d Hammers and %d Swaps.
Earn more with stars and achievements.
A fase %d exige %d estrelas. Faltam %d:: Level %d needs %d stars. You need %d more: replay earlier levels to earn more stars.
Recorde de hoje: %d pontos.\nAmanhã tem:
Today's best: %d points.
A new level comes tomorrow!
Vença a fase diária para ganhar\n+1 Mart:
Win the daily level to earn
+1 Hammer and +1 Swap.
Volte amanhã para ganhar o prêmio:: Come back tomorrow for the prize:
Volte todo dia! Faltam %d dias\npara o p:
Come back every day! %d days
left until the prize:
Abra o jogo 7 dias seguidos: Open the game 7 days in a row
Toque em grupos de 2 ou mais blocos\nda:
Tap groups of 2 or more blocks
of the same color that touch.
Each group is worth points: big groups
are worth a lot more! Reach the goal
before you run out of moves.
Estoure a quantidade pedida de blocos\nd:
Pop the requested number of blocks
of this color before you run out of moves.
The number at the top of the screen
shows how many you have popped.
Agora são duas cores! Estoure a\nquantid:
Now there are two colors! Pop the
requested number of each one.
The top of the screen shows how many
are left of each color.
Estoure blocos até sobrar no máximo\na q:
Pop blocks until no more than
the requested number are left. Watch out
for blocks that end up alone:
they don't pop with a tap.
Joias não estouram. Estoure os blocos\nq:
Gems don't pop. Pop the blocks
below them so they fall down.
When a gem reaches the bottom row,
it is collected.
Você estourou um grupo grande\n(%d bloco:
You popped a big group
(%d blocks or more) and the block you
tapped became a bomb. Tap it to
blow up all the blocks around it!
O coringa combina com qualquer cor.\nEnc:
The wild block matches any color.
Next to a group, it joins the group
and makes it bigger. If you tap it,
it picks the color of the biggest group.
Pedras não estouram com um toque.\nSó a:
Stones don't pop with a tap.
Only a bomb explosion or the
Hammer can break them.
They fall like the other blocks.
Frozen blocks can't be tapped.
Pop a group touching them
to break the ice and free the block.
Este gelo é mais grosso: precisa de\ndoi:
This ice is thicker: it needs
two pops next to it to break.
The first pop cracks the ice.
Este tabuleiro tem buracos.\nOs blocos c:
This board has holes.
Blocks fall through them
normally, as if they
weren't there.
Um desafio novo todo dia, igual para\nto:
A new challenge every day, the same
for every player. You can try
as many times as you want: the first win
of the day is worth +1 Hammer and +1 Swap.
Parabéns! Agora as fases continuam\npara:
Congratulations! Now the levels go on
forever, each one with a challenge.
Stars still earn you powers.
Cada estrela enche o baú: com 30\nestrel:
Each star fills the chest: at 30 stars
it opens and gives you powers.
Every 10 levels there is a boss level.
Beating bosses earns ranks: Bronze,
Silver, Gold and even higher ones.
Esta fase é mais difícil que as outras.\:
This level is harder than the others.
Your first win is worth +2 Hammers
and +2 Swaps, and some bosses give
a new rank. Use your powers!

your streak of %d wins.
Você perdeu uma sequência\nde %d vitória:
You lost a streak
of %d wins.

Win new infinite levels one after
another to build a streak.
Every 5 wins in a row earns
+1 Hammer and +1 Swap. Losing, or
